title: Dispatch return step
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean tape content function, let $p$ be a nonzero integer, and let $side$ and $verdict$ be Booleans. For any Boolean input, input-head position, and output word, one step of the dispatch machine from the return configuration with bookmark and head position both at $p$ and state $(back, verdict, side)$ reaches the local configuration at position $p$, with the same input-head position and output, and state $(answer, verdict, side)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean tape content function
the input is a Boolean word
the input-head position is valid for that input
the output is a Boolean word
